in_marathi.name: Ashu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashu is derived from the Sanskrit word आशु (Aashu) which means 'hope', 'wish' or 'desire'. In Hindu mythology, Ashu is a name of Lord Vishnu and represents the desire and longing in the heart of devotees towards their deity.
